texts.text: Real-time database for GDP in chained volume measures, GBP million (ABMI)
This real-time database shows the quarterly levels for UK GDP in chained volume measures at each publication vintage.
These figures are seasonally adjusted.
M1 represents Preliminary estimate of GDP (no new estimate for nominal GDP)
M2 represents Second Estimate of GDP
QNA stands for Quarterly National Accounts
In July 2018, a new GDP publication model was adopted. Quarterly estimates of GDP have since been published twice a quarter, rather than three times a quarter as happened prior to this.
This data has been taken from successive monthly editions of Economic Trends and Economic and Labour Market Review
Publication dates
The data tables in this spreadsheet were originally published at 07:00 30th September 2026.
The next publication will be published at 07:00 12th November 2026.
Units, notes and no data
Some cells have no data, when this is the case the cells have been left blank. Some cells denote price base changes, these are presented in red square brackets, for example: [2002 prices].
